rejection.policy: Correctness floor 50%; validation-selected threshold: >=70% empirical accepted accuracy, >=15 accepted photos; reject if no threshold qualifies. Also require center-crop agreement and training nearest-neighbor distance <=99th percentile.
rejection.calibration: Logistic top-1 correctness estimator fitted to training-only 3-fold out-of-fold predictions. Does not change dish ranking.
rejection.limitations: Validation contains known dish classes only. This is not validated out-of-distribution detection and cannot identify unseen plain milk.

selection: Training-only 3-fold correctness calibration; C and rejection threshold selected on validation; test evaluated after freezing. Test set has been reused across previous development rounds, so it is not a fresh blind benchmark.
limitations: Unknown classes such as plain milk are absent. All dish profiles require user confirmation.
